next.reason: 2023 has no single list, but each of the three 1985 ways is stated: the CANCEL operand (§2023:14.9.5.4 GR3); EXIT PROGRAM in a called initial program, which runs the GOBACK rules (§2023:14.9.14.4 GR3) where 'an implicit CANCEL statement referencing that program is executed upon return' (§2023:14.9.18.4 GR2); and run-unit termination, after which a program is in its initial state 'The first time ... activated in a run unit' (§2023:14.6.2.3.2 rule 1). GR-8.5.1.11.3 rules concern freeing variable-length storage, not cancellation. GOBACK is new syntax and does not affect 1985 programs.
